failure: Failure: No experimentally established mechanism follows. Cold parallel conduction, vertex zeros, multiband effects, electron feedback, drag and the momentum sink can change or invalidate identification of the collision functional with measured resistivity.
interface: Interface: Temperature is measured in energy units (k_B=hbar=1); W_x is the nonnegative current-relaxation weight, distinct from the susceptibility scaling function W. A smooth-band weak-coupling description, equilibrated bosonic modes with a specified momentum sink, matched neutron-visible/electron-coupled response, and collision functional controlling resistance are assumptions, not acquired facts.
